intro: If you like getting around by boat, want to wake up and wander Tha Nam Non market, or simply need a clean, affordable riverside bed in Mueang Nonthaburi — Bed by Boat Hotel & Apartment is a small, friendly pick that budget travellers in this area mention often · It is a 2-star hotel of around 39 rooms on Soi Pracharat 20, selling easygoing simplicity: clean rooms that feel bigger than the price suggests, kind staff, and a location that is about 700 m from Nonthaburi Pier, where you can hop on the Chao Phraya Express Boat into Bangkok · Guests consistently praise the cleanliness, the comfortable rooms and the food options nearby, from the market to riverside eateries · The trade-offs: it sits in a soi where English is limited around the neighbourhood, a few rooms have had reviews mentioning a musty smell, and it is not aiming for luxury · Rooms from approx. ฿800/night.

body.html: Bed by Boat Hotel & Apartment is a small, owner-run hotel in the Tha Nam Non area, tucked into Soi Pracharat 20 in Suan Yai, Mueang Nonthaburi · It opened around 2005 and had a major renovation around 2020, with about 39 rooms in total · The name Bed by Boat captures its charm directly: it is close to the Chao Phraya River and Nonthaburi Pier, which makes it a natural fit for travellers who want to get around by boat, or to soak up the old-community feel of Nonthaburi's riverside · Its compact size means the service is personal — the kind of place where the staff recognise you.

Rooms come in several layouts: Standard Double with one large bed, Standard Twin with two single beds, Standard Triple for three, and a roomier Deluxe · They are simply furnished and clean, with air-con, a flat-screen TV, fridge, minibar, kettle, safe and a walk-in hot-water shower · The point guests agree on most is that the rooms are clean and feel more spacious and well laid-out than you would expect at this price, and the staff are polite and attentive · One thing to know upfront: a few reviews have mentioned a musty smell in some rooms and noise from cleaning work at certain times · If you are sensitive to smell, ask to switch rooms or run the air-con for a while after check-in.

"The room was clean and bigger than I expected, and the staff were really kind. You can walk to Nonthaburi Pier and take the express boat into town. In the evening there are loads of street-food options and a market nearby — great value for a room like this."

On facilities, Bed by Boat keeps things right-sized for a budget hotel · There is free parking, free Wi-Fi throughout, a lift, a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage · The on-site restaurant serves cooked-to-order breakfast in the morning (sometimes for an extra charge, so it is worth checking when you book) · One thing to understand before booking is that there is no swimming pool and no gym — this is a small hotel that focuses on clean rooms rather than extra amenities · But the area around it has restaurants, convenience stores and Tha Nam Non market with cheap, fresh food, so eating is never a problem.

Location is the heart of this hotel · It sits in the Tha Nam Non area, about 700 m from Nonthaburi Pier, where you can board the Chao Phraya Express Boat into Bangkok — down to Pak Khlong Talat, Sathorn, or to connect with the BTS, a route that dodges traffic and gives you a riverside view along the way · It is near Tha Nam Non market with its cheap food and produce, the handsome old wooden Nonthaburi provincial hall, and several riverside restaurants · For rail, the MRT Purple Line and the railway station are about 2–2.6 km away, reachable by motorbike taxi or taxi · The overall guest score sits around 8.5, which is solid for an affordable 2-star riverside hotel.

Honestly, Bed by Boat is a compelling pick if you want a clean, affordable riverside base, enjoy travelling by boat, or want to stay in the old-community side of Mueang Nonthaburi · Getting a clean, roomy room with free parking, within walking distance of the pier, for around ฿800 is genuinely good value on the riverfront · But if you want a swimming pool, full river views or a proper resort atmosphere, a 4-star option like Riverine Place or Kalanan Riverside Resort will suit you better, even at a higher price · And if you mainly travel by rail and would rather not transfer, a hotel along the Purple Line in the Tiwanon or Bang Yai area will be more convenient.

A tip from following the reviews here: for the full riverside feel, wake up early to wander Tha Nam Non market, then take the Chao Phraya Express Boat into town — it is a scenic route that avoids the traffic · Check the boat timetable in advance, as evening and weekend departures are spaced out more than usual · If you are worried about room odour, ask to see the room first or have the staff run the air-con beforehand · Confirm whether breakfast is included or charged when you book · And always compare prices across Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before you reserve, since promotions differ by platform and season.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Bed by Boat Nonthaburi

faq.q: Where is Bed by Boat, and is it near Nonthaburi Pier?
faq.a: It's at 1/21 Nonthaburi Pier, Soi Pracharat 20, Suan Yai, Mueang Nonthaburi · It's about 700 m from Nonthaburi Pier, where you can walk to catch the Chao Phraya Express Boat into Bangkok, and close to Tha Nam Non market · For rail, the MRT Purple Line (Ministry of Public Health) and Yaek Tiwanon railway station are about 2–2.6 km away by motorbike taxi or taxi.

faq.q: What's the starting price at Bed by Boat, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at approx. ฿800/night for a Standard Double with one large bed · There's also a Standard Twin with two single beds, a Standard Triple for three, and a roomier Deluxe · Prices rise for the larger rooms and during holidays — book ahead and compare across platforms before you reserve.

faq.q: Does Bed by Boat have breakfast and a swimming pool?
faq.a: There's cooked-to-order breakfast in the on-site restaurant in the morning, but it's sometimes an extra charge — confirm whether it's included when you book · There is no swimming pool or gym, as this is a small hotel focused on clean rooms · The area around it has Tha Nam Non market, riverside eateries and convenience stores nearby.

faq.q: Who is Bed by Boat best for?
faq.a: It's great for travellers who want a clean, affordable riverside base, enjoy getting around by boat, like to wander Tha Nam Non market, or are running errands around Mueang Nonthaburi · It has free parking and is a walk from the pier · If you want a pool, full river views or a resort feel, a 4-star option like Riverine Place or Kalanan Riverside Resort will suit you better.

faq.q: What's in the rooms at Bed by Boat?
faq.a: Rooms have air-con, a flat-screen TV, fridge, minibar, kettle, safe and a walk-in hot-water shower · Guests praise the rooms for being clean and more spacious than expected at a 2-star price · One thing to note: a few rooms have had reviews mentioning a musty smell, so if you're sensitive, ask to see the room first or have the air-con run beforehand · There's free Wi-Fi throughout, a lift and a 24-hour front desk.

faq.q: What's the review score for Bed by Boat, and is it trustworthy?
faq.a: Bed by Boat is a 2-star Chao Phraya riverside hotel of around 39 rooms with a guest score of around 8.5 from real guest reviews, which is solid for an affordable 2-star riverside hotel · The strengths guests agree on are clean, roomy-for-the-price rooms, kind staff, and a walk-to-pier location near Tha Nam Non market · It's a go-to for travellers wanting a clean, affordable riverside base in Mueang Nonthaburi.
